concrete.xd.max.note: Largest neutral-axis depth / d allowed for a beam; above it extra steel adds no strength in this check (E-44).

lintel.bearing.note: How far a lintel goes into the wall on each side, used for its span. Engineer hint: common practice 20 cm (NBR 8545, check); in modular masonry maybe half a block to one block (E-34).

lintel.concrete.fck.min.note: Concrete strength of an existing lintel nobody tested, low end. Old or site-mixed lintels can be weak (E-44).

lintel.cover.source: NBR 6118:2014, 7.4.7.2, Tabela 7.2 (viga, classe de agressividade I)
lintel.cover.note: Concrete between the bars and the lintel's bottom face; used for the bars' depth d. Class I = dry indoors; more aggressive places need more (E-44).

load.finishes.min.note: Floor finish + screed + ceiling plaster on a slab, low end. Placeholder until the engineer gives a value (E-43).

load.live.residential.source: NBR 6120:1980, Tabela 2 (edifícios residenciais: dormitórios, sala, copa, cozinha e banheiro)
load.live.residential.note: People and furniture in a home. To confirm against NBR 6120:2019 (E-43).

material.ceramic-block.unitWeight.note: Apparent unit weight of hollow ceramic masonry. The 2019 edition of NBR 6120 lists walls by weight per m² instead; which to use goes to the engineer (E-42).

material.concrete.unitWeight.note: Reinforced concrete (walls, slabs). Plain concrete is lighter.

material.solid-brick.unitWeight.note: 1980 edition value; to confirm against NBR 6120:2019 (E-42).

material.steel.fyk.note: Yield strength of the usual rebar (CA-50). 5 mm bars are often CA-60 (600 MPa); using 500 is on the low side.

safety.gammaC.note: Concrete strength is divided by this (E-44).

safety.gammaF.note: Load factor applied to the weight before comparing with the strength (E-44).

safety.gammaS.note: Steel strength is divided by this (E-44).

slab.joist.selfWeight.min.note: Own weight of a joist slab (beams + blocks + topping), low end. Depends on the system and height; engineer to give values (E-43).

slab.solid.thickness.min.note: Used only when a solid slab's thickness isn't known: low end of the range (E-43).
